a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the build-to-8 plan almost certainly leaves both of us at 0 when round 1 ends. Only 4 cells exist right now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I plan to take 4 this round and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and likely nobody reaches 4. If you have a better idea, say so. If I get my 4 and the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that to rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. It was the only way either of us could reach 4 before a likely storm. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can rebuild for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
